article.headline: Sebastian Mack scores 22 to send UNLV to 82-61 victory over Eastern Washington
article.description: — Sebastian Mack’s 22 points helped UNLV defeat Eastern Washington 82-61 on Monday.
article.linkText: Sebastian Mack scores 22 to send UNLV to 82-61 victory over Eastern Washington
article.story: LAS VEGAS -- — Sebastian Mack’s 22 points helped UNLV defeat Eastern Washington 82-61 on Monday. Mack added seven rebounds for the Rebels (4-3). Tyrin Jones finished with 13 points, nine rebounds and three blocks. Jeremy Foumena totaled nine points and nine boards. Jamil Miller led the way for the Eagles (2-4) with 15 points and seven rebounds. Emmett Marquardt added 12 points, nine rebounds and three blocks. UNLV led Eastern Washington 40-31 at the half, with Mack scoring 12. Up next: UNLV plays Saturday against UT Rio Grande Valley at home, and Eastern Washington visits Loyola Marymount on Wednesday. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
